title: browser sound through the mixer (experimental switch)

clauses.text: Radio and a web video play together through the mixer, and lip-sync looks right

steps.do: Turn on Browser sound through the mixer (experimental) in Settings, Sound (key W). Play the radio and a TikTok video together.
steps.expect: Both are heard without a break. The lips of the video look in step with the sound, not clearly ahead or behind.
